Every page that is in the trimmed PDF (11 pages, notes say 'Read pages 1-11 of 11') is fully captured.

Activity Fund receipts (93,256 of the 174,316) are not itemized. Exhibit B (p2) shows 92,675 of Student Activities program receipts as operating grants and contributions, so part may be donations. Marked review.

The statement prints State Categorical Programs and Federal Programs (disbursements[13], 178,717) as separate function rows, not under Instruction. Classifying them as instruction is a judgment call (marked review). The same applies to detail[41] and detail[42].

County-distributed fines and license fees are classed as fines and forfeitures here. South_Sioux_City_Community_Schools_FY2025 classes the same state code (2110) as intergovernmental/state aid. Both readings are defensible, but the categories should be consistent across reports.
